calibration: temperature (p7_eval.fit_temperature) and threshold (p8_select.choose_threshold) on P8c validation only
clip_rule: clip = max(5.0, ceil(median unclipped pre-clip gradient norm of the sanity trial)); one value for every arm
data: runs/p8/c_training/dataset.pt (178 train roots: P8c train + all P4-P7 history; 12 P8c validation roots); disclosed P8c test (dataset_sealed.pt) is a LEGACY DIAGNOSTIC only, never used for any choice
legacy_comparator: the 21 P8c multi-loss checkpoints (unchanged), evaluated by the same code; reserve 600 CPU-s
matching: torch.manual_seed(seed) before abc8.build(arm) and abc8.RootSampler(train, 12, seed): identical initialization and root batches as the P8c multi-loss run of the same arm and seed
model_version: ABC7_V1 factors (abc8 arm builder), trained from scratch
objective: mean_roots(-log P(D_c), exact equality-aware) + 1.0 * static BCE (deduplicated endpoints) + 1.0 * log-Huber witnessed J; A / SF: the same with the factorized root likelihood (sum of Bernoulli log-losses over the same distinct observed queries)
optional_rule: optional jobs run in listed order only while remaining aggregate CPU after the legacy evaluation reserve exceeds 600 s
selection: best validation mean root NLL (the arm's own exact / factorized likelihood) at every 20 updates, restored
